review.reason: Reviewed shared codec and projection extraction into core, host-clock adapters and original selected-transaction receipt lookup. Publication manual retains manifest CAS, native framing, WAL recovery and stable prepared Agent identities.
Reviewed enum indirection and equivalent validation guards; canonical native object bytes, identities and public serialized fields remain unchanged.
Reviewed released Kingfisher scanner 1.4.0, rules 1.2.1 and core 1.0.3. Updated capture documentation for versioned policy/cache namespaces; privacy failure still withholds publication.

Reviewed standalone Git carrier, focused companion feature and service factory composition. Local manual identifies host admission and filesystem provenance; source operations, owned ref publication and qualified evidence remain unchanged.

Reviewed native and local command/status composition through five factories, current principal/epoch admission and private semantic error adapters. Architecture and publication manuals describe exact original receipts and durable preparation; transport and conversion contracts are unchanged.
Reviewed equivalent native read-context iteration after release lint cleanup. Rebuildable search authority and bounded read behavior are unchanged.
Reviewed sync semantic projection suppressing idle scheduler churn while preserving checkpoint, pause and fault notices; replication authority is unchanged.

Reviewed server conversation-home WorkStore factory composition and local status adaptation. Existing configuration and lifecycle manuals retain their schemas, owned processes and original-request recovery; no new configuration or execution capability is introduced.

Reviewed async local Agent/Work/Review/Thread/Reaction status dispatch through factories. CLI parser, shared help, selector contracts and explicit native service requirements remain unchanged; overview and local technical manual describe the provider boundary.

Reviewed local Work commands and review/collaboration status adaptation through the existing bounded authorized handlers. HTTP routes, schemas, admission and error semantics remain unchanged; regenerated references include the already-committed repository deletion contract.

Reviewed existing confirmed folder removal and native deletion recovery, tab-shaped history/Stacks loading and unique native file ownership since the previous acknowledgement. Settings and browsing guides now describe these exact behaviors; no UI implementation or qualification changes in this documentation slice.

Reviewed the equivalent optional ACP regular-file and symlink guard in Resources::from_root against lifecycle documentation. Fresh desktop Clippy, complete workspace tests, native checking and staged restart acceptance pass; private installation, owner lifetime and independent signed-platform gates remain unchanged.

Reviewed generated OpenAPI against installation and type references. Regeneration adds already-committed repository deletion routes, outcomes and optional capability; store injection adds no wire fields or CLI commands.

Reviewed the maintained local-agent hint and bounded catalog simplifications, unchanged item ordering, lexical synthetic request lock and nonempty request-read assertion against the compute, agent and security guides. Permission/cancellation, backend credential custody, single-attempt metadata and uncertain-inference no-replay behavior retain their exact tests and contracts; native GGUF/live-provider/platform gates remain separate.
Reviewed Cargo distribution metadata only; read-index source, exact-root fingerprints, posting invariants, bounded retention and native authority separation remain unchanged.

Reviewed equivalent forge let-chain guards after strict Rust lint: stale PR identity rejection, retained navigation context and latest-check filtering preserve short-circuit order and documented submission/check/credential semantics.

Reviewed all five core traits, independently named factories, sealed selected participants and Git/native adapters against the standalone guide and executable external host. Guide retains host policy, runtime publication-group compatibility, immutable pins, exact preparation and original receipt recovery.
